title: First-time buyers face higher mortgage costs than rent
summary:
More than half of first-time buyers in the UK are now paying higher monthly mortgage costs than they previously paid in rent, according to research from estate agent Hamptons. The proportion reached 56% last month, the highest level in at least a decade, as mortgage rates climbed above 6% for the first time in three years.

title: Bridging finance secures historic Norfolk pub acquisition
summary:
A specialist lender has provided £244,000 in bridging finance to facilitate the purchase of a Grade II listed public house in Swanton Morley, Norfolk. The deal uses a combination of first-charge commercial and second-charge residential bridging finance.

title: Regulated bridging loan completes in seven days
summary:
Specialist property lender Glenhawk has completed a £559,000 regulated bridging loan in seven days, enabling a borrower to refinance an existing facility ahead of its maturity date. The loan, secured at 50% loan-to-value, was used to redeem a bridging facility that had funded the refurbishment of a residential property.

title: Autumn housing market recovery fails to materialise
summary:
The anticipated autumn recovery in the UK housing market has not materialised, with new data showing listings down 2% year-on-year and sold subject to contract volumes 11% lower across the July to September quarter.

title: UK housing stock reaches decade high as prices stagnate
summary:
The total number of homes available for sale in the UK has reached its highest level for this time of year since 2014, constraining price growth as sellers contend with elevated mortgage rates. Rightmove's latest data shows average asking prices fell in almost five regions last month, with the typical price remaining broadly flat at £371,015.

title: UK property sellers face increased competition as market slows
summary:
UK property price indices have recorded year-on-year falls for the first time this year, with declines of less than 1%. Sellers face a 12-year high in competing properties, with sale times extending by 22 days compared to last year.

title: Marginal performance gains could increase agency revenue by 46%
summary:
Estate agencies could increase fee income by 46.4% from the same number of valuations by improving four key performance metrics by 10% each, according to analysis from property brokerage Moveli. The firm has launched an online calculator that allows agencies to model potential earnings based on conversion rates and fee structures.

title: Independent firms claim top awards at ESTAS 2026
summary:
Independent property firms have secured all four top Grand Prix Gold awards at The ESTAS 2026, according to results announced following the ceremony at London's Grosvenor House Hotel. The awards, determined entirely by verified customer reviews, saw smaller locally-run businesses take top honours across estate agency, lettings, conveyancing and mortgage broking categories.

title: Five characterful homes across England listed for sale
summary:
Five residential properties featuring distinctive interior design schemes have been listed for sale across England, with asking prices ranging from £750,000 to £900,000. The listings span locations from London to Dorset, including period cottages and eco-renovated buildings.

title: Atelier provides £46.1m for Hammersmith office conversion
summary:
Development finance lender Atelier has provided a £46.1m loan to Sheen Lane Developments for the acquisition and conversion of Griffin House, a redundant office building in Hammersmith, west London. The 18-month facility will support the permitted development conversion of the property into studio apartments.
